recommendation:
**These schemes serve completely different life-stage needs and are NOT mutually exclusive.**

🎯 **Choose APY if:** You are 18–40 years old, not an income-tax payer, and earn in the unorganised sector (e.g., daily wage worker, small trader, self-employed). You want guaranteed retirement income starting at age 60.

🎓 **Choose PG-IGSSGC if:** You are a girl student, the only girl child in your family (no brothers), age ≤30, and admitted to a first-year regular PG master's programme in a UGC-recognised institution. You need financial support for postgraduate education now.

✅ **You can pursue BOTH if:** You are a girl student who qualifies for PG-IGSSGC AND will remain a non-income-tax payer until age 40 — then join APY for retirement security after your PG course.

⚠️ **Critical Warnings:**
- APY: If you ever become an income-tax payer, you are barred from 01.10.2022 onwards.
- PG-IGSSGC: Even one brother in your family disqualifies you; distance-mode PG courses are NOT covered.

**For official confirmation and final eligibility checks, contact:**
- APY: https://www.npscra.nsdl.co.in/scheme-details.php | Toll-free: 1800-110-069
- PG-IGSSGC: https://www.ugc.gov.in/page/Scholarships.aspx | Portal: https://scholarships.gov.in
